label: Lava-Core Colossus first encounter

purpose.value: The ancient forge steward banks its furnaces, tempers its voice, and issues the law's fair warning to the armed stranger on the workshop floor; the hero hears every word and misreads industrial machinery turned to defense as heavy ordnance. The guardian attempts communication first; the hero misreads it as a villain's taunt.

emotionalProgression.note: The guardian announces itself and its duty plainly, framed by furnaces and temper.
The warning was honest and complete; being ignored reads as insult.

notes: The scene MUST establish the guardian announcing itself and warning honestly — the law of fair warning means its attack paths will be shown, not hidden. The mercy exit (withdraw) is offered and never taken. Flavor: furnaces and temper. The player's view may hint the guardian's true role; the hero must not perceive it.
